gloss: a corner, a section, one part of

definitions.gloss: a corner, a section, one part of
definitions.explanation: A part or section of a larger area or group. Refers to a specific portion within something bigger.

examples.japanese: ⟦{公園|こうえん}→公園：00581_kouen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{一角|いっかく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦カフェ→カフェ：06767_kafe⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is a café in a corner of the park.

examples.japanese: ⟦{街|まち}→街：17306_machi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{一角|いっかく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦{神社|じんじゃ}→神社：01620_jinja⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is an old shrine in a corner of the town.

examples.japanese: ⟦オフィス→オフィス：00327_ofisu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{一角|いっかく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{休憩|きゅうけい}→休憩：00262_kyuukei⟧⟦スペース→スペース：11049_supeesu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{設|もう}けられている→設ける：14220_moukeru⟧。
examples.english: A rest area has been set up in one section of the office.

notes:
{一角|いっかく} means "one corner" or "a section" of a larger space or group.

FORMS:
{一|いっ} (one) + {角|かく} (corner, angle) = one corner

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- 〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{一角|いっかく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: in a corner/section of ~
- {一角|いっかく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{占|し}める→占める：11799_shimeru⟧: to occupy a section/position
- {一角|いっかく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{担|にな}う→担う：12787_ninau⟧: to play a part in

USAGE:
When read as ひとかど, it means "respectable" or "notable" (as in ひとかど⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人物|じんぶつ}→人物：03356_jinbutsu⟧, a person of some standing). The reading {一角|いっかく} specifically refers to a physical or abstract section.
